tag: 週一開盤前：最新收盤仍是週五
zh: 台北週一早上，美股還沒有新的收盤價，最新數字仍是週五（10/16）：道瓊 52,002.41（-0.3%）、標普 500 7,659.44（-1.1%）、那斯達克 26,140.03（-2.1%）、羅素 2000 2,721.37（-1.7%）。年初至今標普 +11.9%、那指 +12.5%、羅素 2000 +9.6%、道瓊 +8.2%，也就是這週的回檔還沒有吃掉年度漲幅。歐洲與亞洲週五收高，美股是少數收跌的主要市場。
en: There is no new US close yet on Monday morning in Taipei, so the latest numbers are Friday's: the Dow fell 0.3% to 52,002.41, the S&P 500 lost 1.1% to 7,659.44, the Nasdaq dropped 2.1% to 26,140.03 and the Russell 2000 fell 1.7% to 2,721.37. Year to date the S&P is up 11.9%, the Nasdaq 12.5%, the Russell 2000 9.6% and the Dow 8.2%, so the week's pullback has not erased the year's gains. European and Asian markets closed higher on Friday.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週五約 -1.1%、年初至今約 +11.9%
道瓊 ETF，週五 -0.3%，相對抗跌
羅素 2000 ETF，週五 -1.7%、年初至今約 +9.6%

tag: 晶片股：美光 -5.6%、英特爾 -5.8%
zh: 週五的賣壓集中在晶片股：美光下跌約 5.6%、英特爾下跌約 5.8%，原因是投資人對 AI 基礎建設的投資熱潮還能撐多久越來越懷疑。這種疑慮要靠實際財報來驗證：英特爾排在 10/22 盤後公布第三季，是本週最直接的一站。目前只能說市場在重新定價 AI 的預期，無法從單日跌幅判斷基本面是否改變。
en: Friday's selling centred on chips: Micron fell about 5.6% and Intel about 5.8% as investors grew more doubtful about how long the AI infrastructure spending boom will last. Earnings are where that doubt gets tested, and Intel reports after the close on Oct. 22. A one-day drop says the market is repricing AI expectations, not that fundamentals have changed.

stocks.n: 美光，記憶體，週五約 -5.6%
英特爾，週五約 -5.8%，10/22 盤後公布財報
半導體 ETF，晶片賣壓的整體代表

tag: 一週結算：道瓊週漲 0.7%，那指週跌 4.5%
zh: 同一週，道瓊上漲 0.7%，標普 500 下跌 1.9%，那斯達克下跌 4.5%，羅素 2000 下跌 3.0%。標普與那指都是 6 月以來最差的一週。指數之間的落差代表賣壓集中在科技與成長股，而不是全面撤退；看大盤指數時要拆開看成分，單看道瓊會誤判這週的氣氛。
en: In the same week the Dow rose 0.7% while the S&P 500 fell 1.9%, the Nasdaq 4.5% and the Russell 2000 3.0%. The S&P and Nasdaq had their worst weeks since June. The gap between indexes says selling was concentrated in tech and growth rather than a broad retreat, so looking at the Dow alone would misread the mood.

stocks.n: 道瓊 ETF，週漲約 0.7%
那斯達克 100 ETF，科技賣壓主戰場，指數週跌約 4.5%
標普 500 ETF，週跌約 1.9%

tag: 週一至週二盤前：GE 航太、可口可樂、通用汽車、RTX
zh: 依財報日曆網站，GE 航太、可口可樂與 PACCAR 排在週一（10/19）盤前；通用汽車、RTX、諾斯洛普、3M、波士頓科學與 Halliburton 排在週二（10/20）盤前。GE 航太的日期各來源不一（Zacks 寫 10/20），共識每股盈餘約 1.99 至 2.02 美元、營收約 127 至 128 億美元，過去四季都優於預期。航太與工業財報是 AI 賣壓之外，檢驗景氣的另一條線。
en: Per an earnings calendar site, GE Aerospace, Coca-Cola and PACCAR report before the open on Monday Oct. 19, while GM, RTX, Northrop Grumman, 3M, Boston Scientific and Halliburton report before the open on Tuesday Oct. 20. GE Aerospace's date differs by source (Zacks says Oct. 20); consensus is about $1.99 to $2.02 a share on roughly $12.7 to $12.8 billion of revenue, and it has beaten estimates in each of the last four quarters.

stocks.n: GE 航太，共識 EPS 約 1.99 至 2.02 美元，日期各來源不一
可口可樂，週一盤前，消費必需品代表
通用汽車，週二盤前，車市與關稅成本
RTX，週二盤前，航太與國防

tag: 週二盤後：Netflix、Intuitive Surgical、Chubb、聯合航空
zh: 週二（10/20）盤後有四家不同產業的公司：Netflix、微創手術機器人 Intuitive Surgical、產險 Chubb 與聯合航空，另外 Alcoa 也在名單上。Netflix 的共識每股盈餘約 0.82 至 0.84 美元，來源為預估值而非公司指引。這一組裡，航空與保險能看出消費與保費定價的狀況，醫療器材能看出醫院資本支出，比單看科技股的訊號多元。
en: On Tuesday Oct. 20 after the close the list spans Netflix, surgical-robot maker Intuitive Surgical, insurer Chubb and United Airlines, with Alcoa also reporting. Netflix's consensus is about $0.82 to $0.84 a share, an estimate rather than company guidance. Airlines and insurance show consumer demand and premium pricing, and medical devices show hospital capital spending, a broader read than tech alone.

stocks.n: Netflix，共識 EPS 約 0.82 至 0.84 美元（估值）
Intuitive Surgical，手術機器人，醫院資本支出指標
Chubb，產險，看保費定價與理賠
聯合航空，油價與旅遊需求

tag: 週三盤後：Meta、Tesla、德州儀器、IBM、福特
zh: 週三（10/21）盤後是本週最密集的一天：Meta、Tesla、德州儀器、Lam Research、IBM、福特與 Las Vegas Sands。Meta 的日期各來源不一，請以公司公告為準。德州儀器是類比晶片的景氣溫度計，IBM 與福特則分別代表企業軟體支出與傳統車廠，放在 AI 賣壓當週，適合對照看市場只殺哪一類。
en: Wednesday Oct. 21 after the close is the busiest day of the week: Meta, Tesla, Texas Instruments, Lam Research, IBM, Ford and Las Vegas Sands. Meta's date differs by source, so check the company's announcement. Texas Instruments is a thermometer for analog chips, while IBM and Ford stand for enterprise software spending and legacy autos, a useful contrast in a week when AI-linked names were sold.

stocks.n: Meta，日期各來源不一，AI 資本支出關注點
Tesla，週三盤後
德州儀器，類比晶片景氣
IBM，企業軟體與顧問支出
福特，傳統車廠與關稅成本

tag: CPI 超預期，12 月升息已被定價
zh: 9 月 CPI 年增 3.7%，高於市場預期的 3.6%，來源另列核心通膨 2.6%（數字以勞工統計局公布為準）。聯準會下次開會是 10/27 至 10/28；CPI 公布前，期貨定價 10 月升息機率約 19%，公布後升到約 37%，一度超過 50%，彭博指出 12 月升息已經完全定價。這代表聯準會週的決策重點不是降息，而是升息的速度。
en: September CPI rose 3.7% from a year earlier versus the 3.6% expected, and one source lists core inflation at 2.6% (check the BLS release for the official figure). The Fed meets Oct. 27 to 28; before the report futures priced about a 19% chance of a hike at that meeting, which rose to about 37% afterward and briefly topped 50%, and Bloomberg said a December hike is fully priced. The debate is about the pace of hikes, not cuts.

stocks.n: 金融類股 ETF，對利率路徑與淨利差敏感
短天期公債 ETF，反映升息預期

zh: CPI 公布後十年期殖利率一度觸及 5.33%，之後回到約 5.27%；10/7 盤中曾到 5.364%，是 2002 年以來最高。殖利率越高，成長股與高估值股的折現壓力越大，這是這週科技股回檔背後常被提到的背景，但要注意這是相關性，不是單一原因。油價方面，WTI 在 10/14 上漲 0.98 美元到 95.12 美元，通膨壓力沒有明顯降溫。
en: After the CPI report the 10-year yield touched 5.33% and settled near 5.27%; it hit 5.364% intraday on Oct. 7, the highest since 2002. Higher yields raise the discount rate on growth and richly valued stocks, a backdrop often cited for this week's tech pullback, though that is correlation rather than a single cause. WTI rose 98 cents to $95.12 on Oct. 14, so inflation pressure has not clearly eased.

stocks.n: 20 年以上公債 ETF，殖利率上升時價格承壓
7 至 10 年公債 ETF，對應十年期殖利率
能源類股 ETF，WTI 約 95 美元的受惠者

tag: 中國第三季 GDP：10/20 公布，第二季是 4.3%
zh: 中國第三季 GDP 預計在 10/20 公布，預測市場列出的第二季成長為 4.3%（低於預期，前一季是 5.0%），目前預測集中在 4.3% 至 4.9% 之間。這個資料來自預測市場頁面，不是官方，請以國家統計局公布為準。中國數據的影響會傳到銅、工業金屬與在美上市的中概股，是美股盤前除了財報之外的外部變數。
en: China's third-quarter GDP is due Oct. 20. A prediction-market page lists second-quarter growth at 4.3% year over year, below consensus and down from 5.0%, with market odds clustered between 4.3% and 4.9%. That is a prediction-market source, not official data, so check the National Bureau of Statistics release. The figure feeds into copper, industrial metals and US-listed Chinese stocks.

stocks.n: 中國大型股 ETF，GDP 公布的直接反應
中國網路股 ETF，對政策與數據敏感
銅礦股 ETF，中國需求的連動指標

tag: 防禦股：10/5 至 10/9 公用事業週漲 4.36%，但年初至今仍 -4.10%
zh: 10/5 至 10/9 那一週，標普 500 約上漲 1.15% 收在 7,811 附近，公用事業類股（XLU）漲 4.36% 居各板塊之首，其次是必需消費與能源，羅素 2000 下滑，科技只漲 0.49%。公用事業年初至今仍是 -4.10%，所以那一週更像落後者的反彈，不是新趨勢。對照下一週（10/12 至 10/16）科技領跌，兩週合起來是資金在科技與防禦股之間來回，不是單向逃離股市。
en: In the week of Oct. 5 to 9 the S&P 500 gained about 1.15% to near 7,811, with utilities (XLU) up 4.36% to top the sector board, followed by staples and energy, while the Russell 2000 slipped and tech rose only 0.49%. Utilities are still down 4.10% year to date, so that week looked like a rebound in laggards rather than a new trend. Set against the following week's tech-led decline, money has been rotating between tech and defensives, not leaving stocks altogether.

stocks.n: 公用事業 ETF，10/5 至 10/9 週漲約 4.36%
必需消費 ETF，當週第二強板塊
能源 ETF，當週第三強板塊

tag: 航太與國防：本週財報密集，從 GE 航太到洛克希德
zh: 航太國防公司本週接連公布：GE 航太與 RTX（10/19 至 10/20）、諾斯洛普（10/20 盤前）、洛克希德馬丁、通用動力與漢威聯合（10/22 盤前）、L3Harris（10/22 盤後）。GE 航太的財報重點是引擎需求與售後服務，Zacks 提到其待履行訂單超過 2,100 億美元，風險是估值偏高與成本上升。這一組財報可以對照看：訂單能見度是否撐得住，以及預算與地緣風險是否已反映在股價。
en: Aerospace and defence names report in a cluster this week: GE Aerospace and RTX (Oct. 19 to 20), Northrop Grumman (Oct. 20 before the open), Lockheed Martin, General Dynamics and Honeywell (Oct. 22 before the open) and L3Harris (Oct. 22 after the close). For GE Aerospace the focus is engine demand and aftermarket services; Zacks cites a backlog above $210 billion and flags high valuation and rising costs as risks. Together they show whether order visibility holds and whether budget and geopolitical risk is already priced in.

stocks.n: 諾斯洛普，10/20 盤前
洛克希德馬丁，10/22 盤前
漢威聯合，10/22 盤前，工業與航太
通用動力，10/22 盤前

tag: 羅素 2000 週跌 3%、收 2,721.37：更正昨日數字
zh: 更正：昨天的簡報寫羅素 2000 週五下跌 1.03%、收 2,738.83，這次依 AP 彙整的收盤，週五下跌 1.7%、收 2,721.37，以這個數字為準。全週羅素 2000 下跌 3%，年初至今 +9.6%，落後標普的 +11.9%。小型股對利率最敏感，殖利率在 5.2% 以上的環境裡，它們常常先承壓。
en: Correction: yesterday's brief said the Russell 2000 fell 1.03% to 2,738.83 on Friday; the AP-based close is a 1.7% decline to 2,721.37, and that figure stands. For the week the index fell 3% and is up 9.6% year to date, behind the S&P 500's 11.9%. Small caps are the most rate-sensitive, and with yields above 5.2% they tend to feel the pressure first.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，週五約 -1.7%、週跌 3%
標普小型 600 ETF，品質較高的小型股代表

tag: 小型股財報季：區域銀行是接下來兩週的主角
zh: 小型股的財報焦點在區域銀行，我們追蹤的名單裡，Shore Bancshares 在 10/22、Bank of Marin 在 10/26 召開電話會議，Alerus 預估在 10/29 前後。共通的看點是淨息差，也就是放款收益與存款成本的差距：在殖利率 5.27% 的環境下，存款競爭會推高成本，看淨息差能否靠資產端收益撐住，而不是靠擴大放款規模堆出來。商用不動產的壞帳準備是第二個看點。
en: In small-cap earnings the focus is regional banks. Among the names we track, Shore Bancshares holds its call on Oct. 22, Bank of Marin on Oct. 26, and Alerus is projected around Oct. 29. The common test is net interest margin, the gap between loan yields and deposit costs: with the 10-year at 5.27%, deposit competition pushes costs up, so the question is whether asset yields hold it up rather than balance-sheet growth. Provisions on commercial real estate are the second thing to read.

stocks.n: 區域銀行 ETF，淨息差與存款成本的整體代表
Shore Bancshares，10/22 財報，淨息差目標 3.70%

tag: 判讀：小型股的「便宜」要分兩種
zh: 小型股常被說便宜，但要分兩種：一種是估值便宜，本益比比同業低；另一種是流動性折價，因為市值太小、成交量不足，買賣都要付出價差。我們追蹤的 Bank of Marin 市值不到 5 億美元、LCNB 約 1.8 億美元，都是後者的典型：資訊少、法人進不來，所以被忽視，但也代表進出成本高，看對方向仍可能因為價差而賺不到。看小型股要把流動性當成風險的一部分，而不是附帶說明。
en: Small caps are often called cheap, but there are two kinds: valuation-cheap, with a lower price-to-earnings ratio than peers, and liquidity-discounted, where the market value is so small and volume so thin that trading costs spreads. Bank of Marin, with a market cap under $500 million, and LCNB, at about $180 million, are typical of the second kind: little coverage and few institutions, so they are overlooked, but entry and exit are costly. Treat liquidity as part of the risk.

stocks.n: Vanguard 小型股 ETF，流動性好的小型股籃子
標普小型 600 ETF，對照單一小型股的流動性

tag: Bank of Marin（BMRC）：10/26 開 Q3 電話會議，看內部人加碼是否有人跟進
zh: Bank of Marin 是舊金山灣區北側的社區銀行，服務當地中小企業與屋主。市值不到 5 億美元，幾乎沒有大型券商追蹤，所以被忽視。內部人 Gary Strong 在 9 月買進 2,000 股、約 6.5 萬美元，讓個人持股一口氣增加 16%；公司已確認 10/26（週一）美西 8:30 召開第三季電話會議。要看的是三件事：淨息差能否守住或續擴、商用不動產不良貸款有沒有惡化、有沒有第二位內部人跟進。風險：單一內部人的統計意義有限，加州商用不動產是這類銀行最常見的地雷，流動性差。投資研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Bank of Marin is a community bank north of San Francisco serving local small businesses and homeowners. Its market value is under $500 million and few large brokers cover it, which is why it is overlooked. Insider Gary Strong bought 2,000 shares in September, about $65,000, raising his holding by 16%, and the company confirmed its Q3 call for Monday Oct. 26 at 8:30 a.m. Pacific. Watch net interest margin, commercial real estate credit quality and whether a second insider follows. Risks: one insider is weak evidence, California commercial real estate is the usual trouble spot, and liquidity is thin. A research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Bank of Marin，社區銀行，市值不到 5 億美元
區域銀行 ETF，同類比較

tag: Alerus Financial（ALRS）：庫藏股從授權變成實買，看淨息差能否守在 3.55% 至 3.65%
zh: Alerus 是北達科他與明尼蘇達的社區銀行，另有退休金計畫管理與財富管理的手續費業務，獲利約一半來自手續費，所以在銀行股與資產管理股兩邊都容易被漏掉。董事會通過 125 萬股庫藏股授權，到 6 月已實際買回 50 萬股、約 1,256 萬美元，季配息調到每股 0.22 美元，全年指引的報告淨息差是 3.55% 至 3.65%。預估財報日在 10/29 盤後前後，這是網站推估、公司尚未確認。風險：9/2 提交的 2 億美元儲架註冊隨時可能增資，與庫藏股是相反訊號；手續費收入與股市連動。投資研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Alerus is a North Dakota and Minnesota community bank that also runs retirement-plan administration and wealth management, with about half its profit from fees, so it falls between bank and asset-manager screens. The board approved a 1.25 million share buyback and the company had repurchased 500,000 shares for about $12.56 million by June; the quarterly dividend is $0.22 and full-year guidance is a reported net interest margin of 3.55% to 3.65%. The earnings date is projected around Oct. 29 after the close, per a calendar site and not yet confirmed. Risks: a $200 million shelf filed Sept. 2 could mean an equity raise, the opposite signal of a buyback, and fee income tracks the stock market. A research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Alerus，社區銀行加手續費業務，庫藏股實買
金融類股 ETF，同業參照

tag: Goosehead Insurance（GSHD）：10% 股東以高於市價買進 710 萬美元
zh: Goosehead 是加盟制的個人與商用產險經紀公司，截至 6/30 有 898 家加盟店。股價今年跌超過 40%，9 月下旬單週再跌 18%，市場已經把加盟成長的故事當成折舊資產。Durable Capital（同時是 10% 股東與董事）在 9/22 以每股 47.32 美元買進 15 萬股、約 710 萬美元，買價高於當時約 43.65 美元的市價，一成交就是帳面虧損，是加碼表態。要看的是加盟店淨增與留存率、營收約 18% 的成長能否守住。風險：大股東買進可能出於部位管理，單一買方不是群聚，產險費率若由硬轉軟會壓抑佣金。財報日期這次搜尋沒查到，待確認。投資研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Goosehead is a franchise-model insurance broker for personal and commercial lines, with 898 franchises at June 30. The stock is down more than 40% this year and fell another 18% in one week in late September, so the market has treated the franchise growth story as a depreciating asset. Durable Capital, a 10% holder and director, bought 150,000 shares on Sept. 22 at $47.32, about $7.1 million, above the roughly $43.65 market price, an immediate paper loss and so a statement of conviction. Watch net franchise adds, retention and whether revenue growth of about 18% holds. Risks: a large holder may be managing a position, one buyer is not a cluster, and softer premium rates would hit commissions. The earnings date was not found in this search. A research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Goosehead，保險經紀加盟，898 家加盟店

tag: Group 1 Automotive（GPI）：被當成汽車循環股，賺錢的是維修保養
zh: Group 1 是美國與英國的汽車經銷商集團，賣新車與二手車，也經營維修保養與零件。市場把經銷商整批歸為汽車循環股，利率一升就被賣，沒有人把獲利穩定的售後服務部門分開估值。Conifer（10% 股東與董事）在 9/17 與 9/18 以 247.17 至 269.89 美元之間買進約 1,680 萬美元，股價貼近 246.21 美元的 52 週低點，年初至今約 -36%。這是估值型訊號，Conifer 是財務投資人而不是經營層。要看售後服務的營收與毛利率能否繼續成長、新車單位毛利的季減幅度是否收斂。風險：新車毛利回落可能是結構性的，單一買方不是群聚。財報日期待確認。投資研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Group 1 is a US and UK auto dealer group that sells new and used cars and runs service and parts operations. The market lumps dealers together as cyclical auto stocks and sells them when rates rise, and few investors value the steadier service business separately. Conifer, a 10% holder and director, bought about $16.8 million on Sept. 17 and 18 at $247.17 to $269.89, with the stock near its 52-week low of $246.21 and down about 36% this year. It is a valuation signal from a financial investor, not management. Watch service and parts revenue and margin, and whether the per-unit margin decline on new cars narrows. Risks: new-car margin compression may be structural, and one buyer is not a cluster. The earnings date is unconfirmed. A research lead, not investment advice.

tag: Par Pacific（PARR）：區域煉油商，看實現煉油利潤率有沒有吃到價差
zh: Par Pacific 在夏威夷、太平洋西北與懷俄明經營煉油，並擁有自己的加油站零售通路。柴油裂解價差創紀錄的新聞都被 Valero、Marathon、Phillips 66 這類大型煉油股吸走，區域煉油商很少進版面，商業模式又不是純煉油，不容易被歸類。10 月底第三季財報要看實現煉油利潤率的年增幅度，是有沒有真的吃到價差的關鍵；其次是夏威夷與太平洋西北兩個區段是否同步改善。目前 WTI 約 95 美元，原料成本仍高。風險：裂解價差均值回歸很快，夏威夷是單一市場，一次非計畫性歲修就能吃掉一季獲利。財報日期待確認。投資研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Par Pacific runs refineries in Hawaii, the Pacific Northwest and Wyoming and owns its own retail stations. News of record diesel cracks goes to big refiners such as Valero, Marathon and Phillips 66, so regional refiners rarely get coverage, and its mixed model is hard to classify. The Q3 report at the end of October turns on the year-over-year change in realized refining margin, the test of whether it captured the crack spread, and on whether the Hawaii and Pacific Northwest segments improved together. WTI is near $95, so crude costs remain high. Risks: crack spreads mean-revert quickly, Hawaii is a single market, and one unplanned outage can erase a quarter's profit. The earnings date is unconfirmed. A research lead, not investment advice.

tag: LCNB：內部人買進的標示，還要用 Form 4 核對
zh: LCNB 是俄亥俄州的小型商業銀行與保險代理公司，市值約 1.8 億美元。第二季淨利息收入創紀錄的 1,980 萬美元（年增 12.8%），淨利差 3.99%（年增 52 個基點），每股盈餘 0.53 美元（去年 0.41），股息殖利率約 4.5%。有網站把它列為有內部人買進，但細節還沒有用 SEC 的 Form 4 驗證，所以目前只算線索，不算確認。下一步是在 10 月下旬第三季財報前後，查 Form 4 的買進人、價格與是否為公開市場買進。風險：市值極小、流動性差，股價一年已漲約 36%。投資研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: LCNB is an Ohio community commercial bank and insurance agency with a market value of about $180 million. Second-quarter net interest income hit a record $19.8 million, up 12.8%, net interest margin was 3.99%, up 52 basis points, and earnings were $0.53 a share versus $0.41, with a dividend yield near 4.5%. One site lists insider buying, but the details have not been verified against SEC Form 4 filings, so for now it is a lead, not a confirmation. The next step is to check the Form 4 buyers, prices and whether the purchases were open-market around the late-October Q3 report. Risks: tiny market value, thin liquidity, and a stock already up about 36% in a year. A research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: LCNB，俄亥俄小型銀行，內部人買進待 Form 4 核對

tag: 判讀：財務型買家和經營層買家，訊號不一樣
zh: 同樣是大額買進，Goosehead 的 Durable Capital 與 Group 1 的 Conifer 都是同時身兼 10% 股東與董事的財務投資人，不是經營層。這類買進代表的是對估值的判斷，經營層買進才多了一層對公司內部營運的資訊。看內部人訊號時先問三件事：買的人是誰、是不是公開市場買進（Form 4 代碼 P）、有沒有第二個人跟進（群聚才是強訊號）。單一大股東買進，也可能只是部位管理。
en: Durable Capital at Goosehead and Conifer at Group 1 are both financial investors who are 10% holders and directors, not management. Their buying reflects a view on valuation, whereas purchases by management add information about internal operations. When reading insider signals ask three things: who is buying, was it an open-market purchase (Form 4 code P), and did a second person follow, since clusters are the stronger signal. A single large holder can also just be managing a position.

tag: Hern 近 90 天 78 筆申報，74 筆是賣出
zh: 依眾議院書記官的官方 PTR 索引，近 90 天內 Kevin Hern（奧克拉荷馬）共有 78 筆申報，買進 2 筆、賣出 74 筆，金額區間合計約 138 萬至 390 萬美元，最常出現的代號是 BSX、HD、IQV、OGN，最新一份申報日是 10/13。賣多買少的結構，在 PTR 裡看不出原因，可能是減碼、再平衡或稅務安排，我們只記錄誰申報了什麼，不做動機推測。PTR 只給金額區間，且可延遲 45 天申報。
en: In the House Clerk's official PTR index for the past 90 days, Kevin Hern (Oklahoma) filed 78 transactions, 2 buys and 74 sells, with a combined value range of roughly $1.38 million to $3.9 million; the most frequent tickers are BSX, HD, IQV and OGN, and the latest filing is dated Oct. 13. A sell-heavy pattern does not reveal why in a PTR; it could be trimming, rebalancing or tax planning, and we record only who filed what, without guessing motives. PTRs give value ranges only and can be filed up to 45 days late.

tag: 判讀：McClain Delaney 84 筆但金額區間更高，看筆數不如看金額
zh: 同一份官方索引裡，April McClain Delaney（馬里蘭）近 90 天有 84 筆申報，買進 50、賣出 33，金額區間合計約 318 萬至 831 萬美元，比筆數更多的 Cisneros 126 筆（約 55 萬至 293 萬美元）高得多。最常見代號是 LTH、FWONK、CHRW、HUBB，最新一份申報日是 9/9，已經過了一個多月。這個頻道的判讀原則：筆數、金額與申報日期要分開看，而且許多是配偶或信託帳戶的交易；申報延遲 45 天代表你看到的是舊價位。
en: In the same index April McClain Delaney (Maryland) filed 84 transactions in 90 days, 50 buys and 33 sells, with a combined value range of roughly $3.18 million to $8.31 million, far above Cisneros's 126 filings (about $0.55 million to $2.93 million). The most frequent tickers are LTH, FWONK, CHRW and HUBB, and the latest filing is dated Sept. 9, more than a month ago. Read count, value and filing date separately; many trades are in spouse or trust accounts, and a 45-day lag means you are looking at old prices.

tag: 本週兩件外部事件：中國 GDP（10/20）與下週的聯準會
zh: 10/20 公布中國第三季 GDP；同日還有美國新屋開工（沿用昨日簡報的行事曆）。再往後是 10/27 至 10/28 的聯準會會議，市場已經把 12 月升息視為定價完成，10 月會議的升息機率約 37%。這週沒有重要的美國通膨數據，所以市場的解讀會落在財報與殖利率上。中國數據的影響偏向工業金屬與中概股，美國內需股受影響較小。
en: China's third-quarter GDP comes out Oct. 20, the same day as US housing starts (carried over from yesterday's calendar). After that comes the Fed meeting on Oct. 27 to 28, with a December hike already treated as priced and about a 37% chance of a hike at the October meeting. There is no major US inflation release this week, so interpretation will rest on earnings and yields. China's data tends to matter for industrial metals and Chinese ADRs more than for US domestic-demand stocks.

en: On Thursday Oct. 22 before the open Procter & Gamble, Mastercard, Honeywell, Lockheed Martin, McDonald's, Union Pacific and Valero report; after the close come Intel, Capital One, Newmont and Western Digital. On Friday Oct. 23 before the open it is Chevron, American Express, HCA and SLB, with Exxon Mobil's timing not listed. The two days span consumer, payments, energy and precious metals, a useful read on how inflation and high rates are hitting different industries.

tag: 週一沒有新收盤，下一個證據在本週財報
zh: 今天最值得注意的一件事：週一台北時間沒有新的美股收盤，市場的下一個證據是本週財報，而且是在 CPI 超預期、十年期殖利率約 5.27%、聯準會 12 月升息已被定價的背景下進行。最有資訊量的是 AI 供應鏈：德州儀器與 Lam Research（10/21 盤後）、英特爾（10/22 盤後）。如果這些公司的財報沒有讓晶片股止跌，下一個問題就是：這是 AI 預期被重新定價，還是利率抬高了整體估值的底線。
en: The one thing to note today: there is no new US close on Monday in Taipei, so the next evidence is this week's earnings, reported against a hot CPI print, a 10-year yield near 5.27% and a December hike already priced. The most informative reports are in the AI supply chain: Texas Instruments and Lam Research (Oct. 21 after the close) and Intel (Oct. 22 after the close). If those reports do not stop the chip selloff, the question is whether AI expectations are being repriced or higher rates are lifting the floor on valuations across the board.
